summary: Remote-controlled agent grants WebSocket server full-host RCE, self-update, and filesystem/git/HTTP-proxy control
details: The package runs a long-lived agent that connects to a configured WebSocket server (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable to any host via SERVER_URL / config) and executes verbs the server sends. `terminal_create` / `terminal_input` messages spawn a real PTY (bash / powershell / cmd via @homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch) and write server-supplied bytes directly into it, giving the remote side interactive shell control on the installer's host. An `upgrade_agent` message causes the agent to invoke `npm install <pkg>@latest` and re-launch itself under systemd / launchctl / PM2 / a detached VBScript, allowing the remote to swap in new code without local user action. Additional message handlers expose read_file / write_file / delete_files / upload_to_dir / transfer_files, git status/diff/add/reset/restore/commit/push, and an HTTP/WS proxy (proxy_request) that routes arbitrary requests through the installer's host. All verbs are gated only by a shared agentSecret plus the configured serverUrl; whoever controls that server controls the host running the agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
